message.content: Based on the information provided in the data, Wolfgang Schulz did not mention preparing any food for the Lunar New Year celebration in his message to Li Hua. Instead, he wished Li Hua a happy Lunar New Year and expressed excitement about catching up and enjoying some good food together. In the subsequent messages, Li Hua mentioned her plans to cook traditional dishes and get some decorations going, indicating that she was preparing for the festivities. There is no indication that Wolfgang Schulz had already prepared the food for the Lunar New Year celebration. Therefore, it seems that Wolfgang Schulz's message was likely a wish for a wonderful celebration rather than a confirmation of having prepared the food.
